data.title: A Fair Volcano Test
data.description: Change just one thing, erupt both volcanoes, and let the foam tell you.

challenges.instruction: Volcano A has 4 spoons of baking soda and 1 cup of vinegar. Make volcano B with a different amount of vinegar, and keep the baking soda the same. Which erupts higher?
Volcano A has 1 spoon of baking soda and 4 cups of vinegar. Make volcano B with a different amount of baking soda, and keep the vinegar the same. Which erupts higher?
Volcano A has 4 spoons of baking soda and 2 cups of vinegar. Make volcano B with a different amount of vinegar, and keep the baking soda the same. Which erupts higher?
Volcano A has 1 spoon of baking soda and 3 cups of vinegar. Make volcano B with a different amount of baking soda, and keep the vinegar the same. Which erupts higher?
